name: Diagnostic
purpose: Establish where the organisation actually stands, quantify the pain in the client's own numbers, and produce a prioritised roadmap with an ROI hypothesis. This is the wedge: priced to be approved without a board paper.
buyerSignal: Sponsor acknowledges a data problem but cannot yet size it or defend a budget request for it.
scope: Whole-organisation maturity scored across eleven pillars
Data landscape map covering systems, flows and ownership gaps
Top-ten pain quantification with baseline measurement
One candidate domain identified for the first delivery wave
activities: Sponsor and stakeholder interviews across business, risk, finance and technology
Weighted maturity assessment run against the eleven-pillar instrument
System and flow inventory workshop; ownership gap identification
Quantification of rework hours, reconciliation effort, findings and duplicate pipelines
Backward trace from two or three high-value reports to illustrate the CDE method
Roadmap prioritisation and ROI hypothesis construction

deliverables.name: Maturity heatmap and radar scored 1–5 across eleven pillars
Data landscape map with system-of-record and ownership gaps
Quantified top-ten pain list with baselines and owners
Prioritised roadmap with ROI hypothesis and phasing
Illustrative backward-lineage trace for two to three reports
Regulatory exposure summary against reporting and aggregation obligations
AI readiness gap statement per candidate use case

exitCriteria: Maturity scored and validated with the sponsor
Pain quantified in figures the client recognises as their own
Roadmap accepted in principle by the sponsor
qualifiesFor: Blueprint — the client now has a defensible internal case to fund design work.
commercialNotes: Priced below the client's discretionary approval threshold wherever possible.
Credited in full against the Blueprint fee if the client proceeds within an agreed window.
Delivered predominantly by the senior lead — this rung sells the following three.
risks: Interview access denied to the domains that hold the real problems — mitigate by naming required participants in the proposal.
Client expects remediation inside the diagnostic — scope boundary stated explicitly in the contract.

name: Blueprint
purpose: Design the operating model, produce the artefact set that makes governance enforceable, and build the CDE register that everything downstream depends on. This rung produces the single most important artefact in the engagement.
buyerSignal: Diagnostic accepted; sponsor has budget authority and wants a defensible design before committing to build.
scope: Target operating model including roles, councils and decision rights
Policy and standards set with enforcement points identified
Critical data element register derived backwards from consumption
Business case and phased implementation plan
activities: Operating model design workshops; central versus federated split agreed
Charter, policy and standards authoring from the artefact library
Backward lineage from priority returns and board KPIs to derive CDEs
CDE register construction, owner assignment and criticality rating
Tooling evaluation against the client's estate constraints
Wave planning, resourcing model and business case assembly

deliverables.name: Data Governance charter ready for sponsor signature
Target operating model with roles, councils and decision rights
Policy and standards set with named enforcement points
Critical Data Element register with owners and criticality
Tooling recommendation and reference architecture
Business case and phased implementation plan
CDE register pre-seeded from the banking reference model
Regulatory return to source-field lineage templates
Council placement within the existing bank committee hierarchy

exitCriteria: Charter signed by a sponsor with budget authority
CDE register agreed with named owners per element
Tooling decision made and procurement path clear
Implementation waves scoped with a funded first wave
qualifiesFor: Implementation — provided the stewardship gate is met.
commercialNotes: Fixed fee, with the Diagnostic fee credited if taken within the agreed window.
Scope boundary: design and register construction, not platform deployment.
Heavy use of the artefact template library keeps margin intact at fixed price.
risks: Ownership assignment stalls because no one wants accountability — escalate to sponsor early; unassigned CDEs are reported as an open risk rather than quietly absorbed.
Client pushes to select a tool before the operating model is agreed — resist; this is a documented failure mode.

name: Implementation
pricingModel: Milestone-based on wave completion — not time and materials
purpose: Stand up the platform, make quality measurable, install stewardship in one or two domains, and get an issue workflow running. Every wave ends in something demonstrable.
buyerSignal: Charter signed, CDEs agreed, stewards named with allocated time.
scope: Catalogue, glossary and lineage deployed and populated for scoped domains
DQ rules authored and executing against governed CDEs
Stewardship operating in one or two domains — not enterprise-wide
Issue management workflow live with triage SLA
activities: Platform deployment and connector configuration
Metadata harvest, glossary population and term-to-asset binding
Lineage capture across scoped source-to-consumption paths
DQ rule authoring against CDEs, drawing on the rule library
Scorecard construction and publication cadence established
Steward onboarding, issue workflow rollout, first council cycles run
Remediation of the highest-severity defects surfaced

deliverables.name: Catalogue, glossary and lineage live for scoped domains
Executable DQ rules bound to every governed CDE
Published data quality scorecard with named owners
Issue management workflow live with triage SLA
Stewardship operating in the scoped domains
Policy enforced as code at a minimum of one pipeline gate
Core banking rule library deployed across CIF, accounts, GL, loans, cards, collateral
Return reconciliation and lineage evidence pack

exitCriteria: Scorecard published and reviewed in a council meeting
Defect rate demonstrably moved on a defined set of rules
Issue workflow processing real issues within SLA
Stewards operating independently of the delivery team
qualifiesFor: Managed Governance — the capability exists and now needs to be run and expanded.
commercialNotes: Milestones tied to wave exit criteria, which forces scoping discipline on both sides.
Delivery carried primarily by data engineers with senior oversight, protecting blended economics.
Scope expansion handled as an additional wave rather than absorbed.
risks: Steward time quietly withdrawn after kickoff — monitored as a standing council agenda item.
Source-system metadata extraction blocked by a vendor core — identified and de-risked during Blueprint, not here.
Client attempts enterprise-wide rollout mid-programme — governed by the CDE-scoping principle.

name: Managed Governance
pricingModel: Monthly retainer, tiered by governed domains and CDE count, with SLAs
purpose: Run the capability rather than hand it over and hope. This is the annuity — and the reason this is a business rather than a project shop.
buyerSignal: Implementation complete; client lacks the internal headcount or discipline to sustain cadence unaided.
scope: Monthly scorecard production and issue triage
Quarterly onboarding of new domains and systems
Fractional CDO advisory to the sponsor
activities: Run the council: agenda, papers, decisions, minutes, follow-through
Maintain catalogue coverage and glossary currency as the estate changes
Author and retire DQ rules as consumption changes
Produce and publish the monthly scorecard; triage and escalate issues
Onboard additional domains or systems each quarter
Advise the sponsor on strategy, regulatory change and investment

deliverables.name: Monthly data quality scorecard with trend and commentary
Issue triage within SLA with escalation reporting
Council meeting pack, decisions log and action tracking
Quarterly domain or system onboarding
Fractional CDO advisory to sponsor
Regulatory change impact assessment on governed elements
Examination and audit evidence pack maintained current

exitCriteria: Not applicable — this is the steady state. Reviewed annually against coverage growth and defect-rate trend.
qualifiesFor: Expansion into further domains, or a new Diagnostic in an adjacent entity or subsidiary.
commercialNotes: Tiered by number of governed domains and CDE count, with defined SLAs on triage and scorecard publication.
Work outside the retainer scope billed at a premium spot rate — this protects the retainer from erosion.
Annual term with a notice period; the annuity only works if it is not month-to-month.
risks: Retainer erosion through absorbed scope creep — enforced by a written in-scope/out-of-scope schedule.
Client builds internal capability and insources — anticipated; position the retainer as reducing over time by design and retain the advisory tier.
